title: PaymentStatus DECLINED renamed to REJECTED
query: What breaks across repositories if the payment result enum DECLINED is renamed to REJECTED?

affected_repositories.name: payment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns PaymentStatus, Payment, MyBatisPaymentStore.valueOf mapping, and PaymentCommandService topics

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: SagaResultListener consumes payment.declined.v1 and SagaTransitions keys payment.declined for compensation

notes: Enum rename across the saga compensation boundary. A declined payment that no consumer recognizes skips inventory release, leaking reservations: the blast radius is a state-machine defect, not a display bug.
